catalog.evolution: level-only + Eevee-style branching + form-aware regional descendant routing
catalog.policy: canonical official forms + exactly 36 approved PMDCollab Mega behaviour forms; presentation-only resource slots are never species
catalog.retired_id_policy: remove presentation-only entries from active catalog/lock but never reuse their old internal IDs; keep tombstone migration map
catalog.save_migration: retired presentation-only species IDs automatically canonicalize to the base or canonical regional form while preserving pet stats/level/IV/nickname

power.wake_source: AXP2101 physical side button short press

deployment.workflow_name: TamaPoke v3.62.8 PMDCatalog - SingleRelease FullSD + BasePackGuard + Canonical Forms + Regional Evolutions + Framed PUT4 Stable WebSerial + Mega36 GitHub Pages

save_note: User plans to wipe old save data; backward save compatibility is not a blocking constraint.
latest_changes: Web Serial installation UI and regional/all-sprite workflow are unchanged; only the transport protocol is upgraded.
SDINFO reports proto=4 and the current installer requires proto>=4.
PUT4 frames every 2 KiB block with sequence number, length and IEEE CRC32.
Firmware exact-read loop accumulates fragmented USB CDC reads until the full framed payload has arrived.
Numbered ACK/NAK enables safe per-block retry; duplicate already-written blocks are ACKed without a second SD write.
END4 keeps the session open through final-block ACK recovery and validates whole-file CRC before commit.
Transfers write to .part and use .bak4 guarded replacement so a failed transfer does not overwrite the previous valid sprite.
PUTSTAT recovers the rare case where the file was committed but DONE4 alone was lost.
Legacy raw PUT remains in firmware for backward compatibility, but the v3.62.8 installer uses PUT4 only.
Large PC full-sprite ZIP is no longer uploaded through actions/upload-artifact, avoiding the full bundle consuming Actions artifact storage.
Full sprite ZIP now uses one rolling GitHub Release tag sprites-current with stable asset TamaPoke-SD-Sprites-Current-Full.zip.
Legacy large Actions artifacts named TamaPoke-vX.Y.Z-full-sd-sprites are enumerated through the Actions REST API and deleted on the next successful build.
Each successful build replaces the same sprites-current asset instead of accumulating one large Release asset per firmware version.
Workflow removes only legacy auto-generated sprite Releases matching sprites-vX.Y.Z and their tags after the rolling asset is published.
Pages sprite-bundle.json is rewritten to the stable sprites-current download URL and records generated_filename, release_tag, and storage_policy.
New verify_release_storage_policy.py fails CI if versioned sprite Release tags or full-ZIP Actions artifact backup are reintroduced.
Installer exposes a device-independent PC full-sprite ZIP download button driven by sprite-bundle.json

Full SD ZIP independently rejects AltColor/Alternate/Cutscene/Beta and retired managed IDs, includes SHA256SUMS/credits/audit metadata, and is published as a GitHub Release asset with an Actions artifact backup
GitHub Actions builds one versioned PC full microSD ZIP containing root mons/ from audited Gen1-7 base packs plus the exact current 810+/official-form/Mega36 catalog
Installer validates base TPAK filenames, exact regional ID ranges, TPK2/TPK3 magic and duplicates before transfer
Gen1-7 base sprite packs are pinned to immutable audited commit 7d5a2b3f4a4bee4f107cdae77ad13949dddfc615; mutable main/latest fallbacks removed

sprite_transfer.catalog_fingerprint: generated by Actions in sprite_audit.json / sprite-manifest.json
sprite_transfer.visual_audit: GitHub Pages resource audit tab with ID/NatDex/PMDCollab path + preview
sprite_transfer.failure_policy: automatic block retry + one file retry; only close WebSerial/reboot after recovery is exhausted
sprite_transfer.delete_command: DEL mons/pNNN.bin / mons/psNNN.bin (restricted to retired sprite binaries under /mons)
sprite_transfer.retired_cleanup: all-added and all-sprite sync remove manifest.retired_files before writing current canonical assets
sprite_transfer.framing: BLK4 + seq(u16) + len(u16) + crc32(u32 LE) + payload
sprite_transfer.completion_recovery: PUTSTAT <path> verifies last committed size/CRC if DONE4 is lost

features: SingleRelease FullSD storage guard: one rolling sprites-current Release asset; no full-ZIP Actions artifact; legacy generated sprite Releases cleaned

PC full microSD sprite ZIP: root mons/ bundle, stable Release download button, SHA-256 manifest

full_sd_sprite_zip.canonical_guard: presentation-only variants and retired IDs forbidden
full_sd_sprite_zip.legacy_cleanup: delete only auto-generated sprite Releases matching sprites-vX.Y.Z after sprites-current is safely uploaded
